ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, thank you for submitting your feedback. We are sorry to learn about the trouble you have with lighting your grill and reaching desired temperatures. This is not what we expect from our Spirit II E-310. It sounds that your grill is under a bypass safety mode. We suggest turning your tank off after every use. Next time you use your grill, please follow these steps.
1. Open the lid
2. Make sure all knobs are in the off position.
3. Fully disconnect your tank from the rubber hose and reconnect it.
4. Open your LP tank slowly fully open.
5. Allow the gas to pressurize for a full 60 seconds.
6. Turn the first burner to start/high (first position to the left)
7. Hit your igniter
8. Turn on all remaining burners
9. Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F
We strongly suggest cleaning your burners, including your crossover tube, with a clean stainless steel brush. If you continue to have outstanding questions, please contact us at reviews@weberstephen.com. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

2. Make sure all knobs are in the off position.

3. Fully disconnect your tank from the rubber hose and reconnect it.

4. Open your LP tank slowly fully open.

5. Wait one full minute-60 seconds.

6. Turn the first burner to start/high (first position to the left)

7. Hit your igniter

8. Turn on all remaining burners

9. Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F
If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact us at reviews@weberstephen.com. Thank you!
